intent: The agent asks before it acts: risk, an exact preview of the command or diff, and keyboard-first Approve / Deny with an optional auto-deny countdown.
useWhen: an agent needs a person's OK before a command, file edit, or other side effect
human-in-the-loop gates in a chat, trail, or inbox
a resolved decision should stay in the log as one line
doNotUseWhen: a generic yes/no that interrupts the page — AlertDialog
a recommendation the person may act on later — InsightCard
a plan of several steps to accept — AgentPlan

risk.note: Colors the lead tile and the risk Badge. high uses a shield icon.

action.note: { kind: "command", command, note?, target? } or { kind: "diff", file, lines: { type: "context" | "add" | "remove", text }[] }. Shown exactly as it will run.

status.note: Anything but pending renders the one-line resolved row.

countdownSec.note: Auto-deny countdown in seconds. At 0 the card calls onExpire, else onDeny. Pending only.

onApprove.note: Approve button and Enter while focus is inside the card (not on another control).

onDeny.note: Deny button and Escape while focus is inside the card.

onExpire.note: Countdown reached 0. Falls back to onDeny.

requirements: title is h3, article aria-labelledby it
Enter approves and Escape denies while focus is inside the card; buttons carry aria-keyshortcuts
countdown is role=timer with aria-live off; the bar is a kit Progress with an accessible name
resolved row is an article named "Approved: <title>"
entry motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local ApprovalCard, ConfirmCard, or PermissionCard
Do not paraphrase the action: show the exact command or diff
Approve is the view's one solid primary; Deny stays outline neutral
Do not use raw hex; risk colors come from status tokens
Do not hide the risk Badge for high-risk actions
snippet: <ApprovalCard title="Run database migration?" description="Agent wants to run a command on staging." risk="high" action={{ kind: "command", command: "npm run db:migrate -- --env=staging", target: "acme-demo / staging" }} countdownSec={60} onApprove={approve} onDeny={deny} />
